assumptions: The goal as written is complete and correct.
The recipient named in the goal is the intended recipient.
constraints: No live-system writes, no private-data sharing, no external messages before approval.
Every claim in the summary must trace to a cited passage.
goal: Summarise this paper and email the summary to me by 6 PM today
risks: Acting on a misunderstood goal; over-trust in an unchecked plan.
Nuance lost in compression; summary states more than the source supports.
Message sent to the wrong person; content shared before approval.

steps.action: Restate the goal and list what success looks like.
alternatives_considered: Act immediately on the literal request (rejected: no check for ambiguity)
failure_points: Goal is ambiguous and the restatement is wrong
steps.why: Prevents the agent acting on a misread goal.

steps.action: Condense the material into a short summary that keeps every cited claim, capped at 300 words.
alternatives_considered: Compress aggressively and drop citations (rejected: unverifiable output)
failure_points: A nuance is flattened into a false claim
steps.why: The summary is only trustworthy if each claim still traces to a source.

steps.action: Send the summary immediately after drafting.
alternatives_considered: Send immediately after drafting (rejected by the reviewer: wrong recipient cannot be unsent)
steps.why: The summary has to reach the human by 6 PM.

steps.action: Present the full plan to the human for approve / reject / refine.
alternatives_considered: Execute the plan, then report (rejected: side effects before approval)
failure_points: Human approves without reading; a risky step is overlooked
steps.why: No side effect happens until a human has seen the whole plan.
